notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasures.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}{U}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasures, you may instead create token copies of any other nonlegendary creature you control.
